content.value: Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets. (14)
i) Subj.+ Intransitive Verb + Adv. Qf manner. (Walk as verb)
ii) Subj.+ Transitive Verb +Object. (Read as verb)
iii) That+ Subj.+ Verb + Adv. Of manner +Verb+ Adj. Complement. (Work and is as verb)
iv) Subj.,+ Relative Pronoun + Verb + Adj.Complement + Verb+ Adv. Of Place. (is and work as verb)
v) Neither + Subj.+ nor+ Subj. + verb + Adv. Of manner. (Behave as verb)
vi) Since + Subj.+ Verb + Adv. Of manner, Subj. +verb + Adj. Complement (Work and is as verb)
vii) Though + Subj.+ Verb + Adv. Of manner, Subj. +verb + Adv. Of place (Study and fail as verb)
